answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware-enforced remote attestation. Each node runs within a secure enclave whose cryptographic kernel measures system state. A decentralized raven monitor dispatches challenges that agents must sign using manufacturer-fused keys, ensuring an adversary cannot forge identities without procuring scarce physical security chips for each instance. However, this creates vendor lock-in and remains vulnerable to hardware-level side-channel exploits.
